summary: This video features a 300-pull summoning session on the Selected Summons II banner to acquire Holfast via the pity selector. The creator breaks down the inspiration breakpoints for Anneliesis, noting that stopping at Inspiration 3 is optimal for general content as Inspiration 4 and 5 are primarily useful for Magic Chess. Additionally, the creator explains that the 30% Damage Up buffs from Anneliesis's Inspiration 5, Holfast, and Lincos do not stack with each other. Holfast is highlighted as a critical addition for Continental Challenge, where Aura teams dominate and heavily amplify Talethia's damage output.

heroes.name: Holfast
heroes.verdict: Top-tier support for Aura teams; aim for Inspiration 2
heroes.note: Significantly amplifies Talethia's damage output and helps Aura teams dominate Continental Challenge.

heroes.name: Anneliesis
heroes.verdict: Build to Inspiration 3; push to Inspiration 5 only for Magic Chess
heroes.note: Her Inspiration 5 30% Damage Up buff does not stack with the identical 30% buffs from Lincos or Holfast.

heroes.name: Lincos
heroes.verdict: Solid Aura support and damage dealer
heroes.note: His ultimate provides a 30% Damage Up buff that does not stack with Holfast's buff or Anneliesis's Inspiration 5.

heroes.name: Talethia
heroes.note: Her damage performance increases dramatically when supported by Holfast.

teams.note: Aura team core setup that ranks as the best performer in Continental Challenge.

meta_changes: Aura teams led by Holfast and Talethia represent the top-performing archetype for Continental Challenge.
tips: Do not pull beyond 300 summons on the Selected Summons banner because the base rates are poor; wait for Option Summons banners for extra copies.
Stop upgrading Anneliesis at Inspiration 3 unless you specifically want to optimize for Magic Chess.
Do not rely on overlapping 30% Damage Up buffs from Anneliesis (Inspiration 5), Holfast, and Lincos, as they do not stack.
Aim to get Holfast to at least Inspiration 2 for significant performance gains.
title: 300 SUMMONS! Hunting HOLFAST in Selected Summons II | Dragonheir: Silent Gods
